name: Donor Wall - Anonymity Beside Named Donors
description: The guarantee made visible. An anonymous donor sits between named ones with their name, photo, and outbound link all withheld, while their giving level and Founding badge still show — anonymity hides who they are, not that they gave. They also sort under A, where a reader sees them, so the alphabetical run never hints at the withheld name's first letter. The last entry carries a tier the page no longer declares and still reaches the wall, under Other supporters.
